question: What is the meaning of compositional elements in relation to product information?
description: Compositional elements refer to the materials and substances that make up a product. In the context of product information, these elements are specified by their mass fraction, expressed as a percentage of the total mass of the product. The product composition declaration lists all disclosed chemical substances in the product at a specified threshold, which is chosen among four levels: 10 ppm, 100 ppm, 0.1%, or 1%. This information is publicly available and validated by conformity assessments or standards.
